Scope header mechanism correctly cites migrationScope()/declaresPublicScopeHeader() at the correct line numbers. Design is Type E prose only, no implementation code. One gap identified during validation (not a BLOCKER, flagged for BACKEND-DEV attention): the design's 'Migration runner interaction' section does not mention the ISS-0604/GH-470 MigrationScopeMismatch guard (declaresUnqualifiedTableWork()), which will reject the -- scope: public header on 031/050 unless their unqualified DDL is also schema-qualified in the same change. Routed to BACKEND-DEV with this note rather than sent back for rework, since the design's core approach (scope header + corrective drop) is correct and complete; the qualification requirement is a mechanical consequence BACKEND-DEV must apply during implementation, not a design defect.
